name: go-cap-tests
cmd: bun install --frozen-lockfile >/dev/null 2>&1 && . research/extract/go-setup.sh && export GDP_GO_SNAPSHOT=/tmp/snap-tests.jsonl GDP_GO_CAPTURE=/tmp/cap-tests.jsonl && (cd core && timeout -s KILL 1300 bun test extract-go.test.ts 2>&1 | tail -5); echo '--- snapshot'; cat /tmp/snap-tests.jsonl; echo '--- capture'; mkdir -p /olean/gocap && gzip -9c /tmp/cap-tests.jsonl > /olean/gocap/cap-tests.jsonl.gz && ls -la /olean/gocap; echo '--- end'

name: go-cap-realworld
cmd: bun install --frozen-lockfile >/dev/null 2>&1 && . research/extract/go-setup.sh && export GDP_GO_SNAPSHOT=/tmp/snap-rw.jsonl GDP_GO_CAPTURE=/tmp/cap-rw.jsonl && timeout -s KILL 2400 bun research/extract/go-run.ts --out /tmp/xg 2>&1 | tail -3; echo '--- results'; cat /tmp/xg/results.jsonl; echo '--- snapshot'; cat /tmp/snap-rw.jsonl; echo '--- capture'; mkdir -p /olean/gocap && gzip -9c /tmp/cap-rw.jsonl > /olean/gocap/cap-rw.jsonl.gz && ls -la /olean/gocap; echo '--- end'
